Elena —

Thanks for sending these over and for the quick detail. A few items the procurement/risk teams need clarified before we can issue the PO: 

1) Endorsement wording: We require the carrier to add Redwood Inference, Inc. as an "Additional Insured" with primary and non-contributory wording and waiver of subrogation where applicable. If your carrier provides a CG 2028 or equivalent endorsement, please include.
2) Certificate holder: Please list
   Redwood Inference, Inc.
   300 Bryant St, Suite 200
   Palo Alto, CA 94301
3) Retroactive date / prior acts on professional liability (if applicable) — confirm if claims-made or occurrence.
4) SIR/deductible: if GL or E&O deductibles exceed $25k, include plan for bridging or confirmation.
5) W-9: Procurement needs your W-9 or US tax equivalent to create the supplier profile.

Looping in Laura (procurement) for PO timing and Marissa (vendor risk) for the endorsement language check — Marissa, any additional asks?

If you expect the carrier to provide an endorsement, it typically takes 48–72 hours once requested. If you want, we can accept a pending endorsement with a formal ETA and follow up after the carrier issues the updated COI.

Thanks,

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>, Elena Martinez <elena@novaterra.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Initial docs: COI + risk questionnaire attached

Elena —

Thanks for the questionnaire and COI. A quick vendor risk review: 

- The GL limits look acceptable but we need the endorsement text on record (we typically require: "Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents are named as additional insured" with primary & non-contributory language). Please ask your broker for an endorsement form (CG 20 10/CG 20 26 or equivalent).
- For E&O/Professional Liability: confirm whether the policy is claims-made. If claims-made, we need the retroactive/prior acts date to be at or before the start of the contract.
- Deductible/SIR: confirm a maximum of $25k exposure to Redwood; if higher, include mitigation steps (e.g., escrowed funds or a separate performance bond).
- If Novaterra will process or store PII, please attach your latest SOC 2 Type II report or a third-party security attest. If not available, we will require a security questionnaire + an SSP summary.

I attached a one-page checklist that highlights the fields we verify on the COI — this often speeds carrier responses.

Attachment: vendor_insurance_checklist_for_redwood.pdf (1 pg)

Once we have the endorsed COI and W-9, I will mark the risk review complete and signal procurement to finalize the PO.

Marissa Cole
Vendor Risk Analyst
Redwood Inference
